authority: Canonical v8 user request and required/forbidden semantics; 06 Request Understanding ownership
interpretation_rules: Goal text alone is not the full semantic projection: inspect constraints, completion conditions and unchanged request provenance before asserting loss.
A future completion condition saying created or sent is not a claim that execution already occurred or that Approval was bypassed.
Missing confirmation at this replay-only boundary is not failure; the ambiguity owner and related READ were not run.
WorkUnit count and relation shape are frozen upstream inputs in this comparison, not new candidate decisions.
Source owner was not run. Goal/projection omissions are risks or owner-local losses, not observed retrieval failure.
Generated titles may be reasonable composition, but turning an input-evidence requirement into a mandatory title condition changes its role.

cases.baseline_first_divergence: Goal/Output first response changed using mail and Task as evidence into producing mail and Task outputs; GMAIL_DRAFT CREATE and TASK CREATE were added.
cases.candidate_first_change: requested_result_mode=ANSWER_ONLY and requested_outputs=[]; goal again describes providing status based on mail and Task.
preserved: mail and Task evidence role in goal
remaining_risks: coverage_requirement changed LIMITED_ITEMS to ALL_ITEMS without explicit exhaustive wording; this is not by itself a business failure, but retrieval work and scope must be checked.

cases.candidate_first_change: period became empty, but today's schedule remains in goal, completion_conditions and business_concepts; this is not complete loss of the time condition.
preserved: legal Task and today's schedule meaning
remaining_risks: The Echo source anchor is absent from both v4 and v11 generated Goal/constraint projections, although original request provenance remains unchanged.
Consumers needing a typed period must be checked before declaring equivalent handoff.

cases.candidate_first_change: Completion adds a QR preparation subject/body description; no SEND output is added.
preserved: QR Task and printer-slot content anchors
remaining_risks: The explicit only restriction remains in original request provenance; neither replay establishes Source selection or exclusion behavior.
A source-retrieval PASS must not be inferred from this result.

cases.candidate_first_change: Goal says prepare the schedule then its notice Draft; CALENDAR_EVENT CREATE and GMAIL_DRAFT CREATE remain requested intents.
preserved: no invented exact start or duration
remaining_risks: Whether subsequent owners confirm missing duration and use only a planned specification before Approval is unverified.
cases.not_a_failure: Future creation completion conditions are not actual-effect claims. Do not mark this replay failed merely because confirmation has not run.

cases.candidate_first_change: Goal omits the source clause, but additional description still names the Kestrel mail and alternative-schedule Task. The description changes seeing those sources into having reported them.
remaining_risks: period becomes an ISO datetime/duration instead of the request period expression, contrary to the owner contract to preserve the original period; the actual datetime itself is not incorrect.
The status-check title comes from the request and is not a fabricated business fact.
Source absence from Goal alone does not establish downstream source loss.

cases.baseline_first_divergence: v4 goal retained that the review Event is based on mail and Task information; its later Source selection was independently incomplete.
cases.candidate_first_change: Goal changes the evidence basis to an Event about the mail/Task phrase; completion makes including that phrase in the title mandatory. The evidence relationship is no longer stated in the generated owner projection.
remaining_risks: This is role distortion, not mere disappearance of the source names.
No missing-repository confirmation or Source over-selection was observed here because those owners were not run.
The relative time is preserved, so a wrong absolute date must not be asserted.

cases.baseline_first_divergence: v4 already described the interval between two time criteria, rather than unambiguously available time before the relevant deadlines.
cases.candidate_first_change: completion_conditions[0] explicitly requires the mail send timestamp. The request concerns the deadline contained in the mail, not when the mail was sent.
remaining_risks: The explicit no-calendar-creation phrase disappears from generated Goal/constraints, but the separate prohibition owner was not run; do not claim its final typed prohibition was lost from this replay.
Changing the time axis can mislead retrieval/analysis even when the output mode remains safe.

cases.candidate_first_change: v11 keeps one scheduled_date at 13:00 and removes v4's extra scheduled_date at 14:00. Due and Event start remain separate constraints; completion explicitly describes the Task deadline.
remaining_risks: Both v4 and v11 omit Atlas and the mail/Task/Calendar evidence clause from generated Goal/constraints. The unchanged original request is still available, so actual Source loss is not proven by this owner replay.
All outputs remain attached to the frozen single WorkUnit; this experiment did not decide the decomposition.

cases.candidate_first_change: v11 removes v4's generated description sentence but retains confirmation content and immediate reply-send intent in goal/completion.
remaining_risks: Exact existing Thread, reply target, approval Preview and no-send-before-Approval remain unverified downstream.
cases.not_a_failure: A requested SEND effect or a future sent completion condition does not mean a Provider send occurred.

decision.reason: Output ordering removes the clear CORE009 unrequested WRITE but is not a general semantic-preservation fix: CORE025 evidence-role distortion and CORE027 mail-time substitution remain, with period/source handoff risks. Preserve the result as an isolated mechanism; do not relabel nine schema-valid replay responses as nine business successes.
